svg.title: Bantuin symbol-micro black
svg.metadata: {"authoring":"native-vector","brief":"Original Bantuin mark: a capital B formed by folded planning-document shapes and deliberate negative space. Friendly geometry, compact silhouette, legible at small sizes. Flat single color with clean paths. Derive variants from one parent mark. symbol-micro composition, black variant. Lettering outlined from the pinned Manrope font."}
